process.heading: How an Edstellar performance coaching program runs.
process.description: Six steps take each person from nomination to a final summary they control, over six to eight months. Your CHRO sees progress at every step; the coaching itself stays between person and coach.

steps.label: Nominate the person
steps.title: Nominate the person
steps.description: Your CHRO or program admin adds the person on Meridian with their role, the capability they want to build and their focus areas. The person agrees to take part.

steps.label: Match a coach
steps.title: Match a coach
steps.description: In a 30-minute video session, the person reviews the certified coaches Meridian recommends and chooses one. The CHRO can join this session if the person wants them there.

steps.label: Chemistry session
steps.title: Chemistry session
steps.description: A free 30-minute session to test the fit, confirm the objective, choose one of the six performance tracks and agree the schedule.
steps.who: Person and coach · live on video

steps.label: Coaching sessions
steps.title: Coaching sessions
steps.description: Ten to twelve hours of one-on-one coaching on Meridian. The person sets the focus, the coach prepares, and an assignment carries the work forward.
steps.who: Person and coach · live on video

steps.label: Mid-point check-in
steps.title: Mid-point check-in
steps.description: Halfway through, person and coach review progress against the objective and adjust the plan for the hours ahead.
steps.who: Person and coach · live on video

steps.label: Final review and summary
steps.title: Final review and summary
steps.description: The final session agrees what the person will keep doing, and they choose what the CHRO sees in the final summary.

process_cta.description: A 30-minute walkthrough of coach matching, the session room and the view your CHRO sees, set up around your team.

items.question: What is performance coaching?
items.answer: Performance coaching is one-on-one professional coaching focused on building one specific capability — such as confidence, resilience, focus or communication — in people who are already capable but want to do something better. Edstellar's program pairs each person with a certified coach for ten to twelve hours over six to eight months, run on Meridian.

items.question: Who is performance coaching for?
items.answer: Performance coaching is for high performers taking on more, people in high-pressure roles, talented people held back by confidence rather than capability, and employees recovering from a professional setback.

items.question: How long does a performance coaching engagement last?
items.answer: Ten to twelve hours of one-on-one coaching over six to eight months. The session length and schedule are agreed in the free chemistry session.

items.question: What certifications do Edstellar coaches hold?
items.answer: Every Edstellar coach is certified by the International Coaching Federation (ICF) at PCC or MCC level, the International Coaching Community (ICC) or the European Mentoring and Coaching Council (EMCC). Coaches are also vetted by Edstellar before Meridian can recommend them.

items.question: How does Edstellar match a person with a coach?
items.answer: Meridian recommends certified coaches based on the person's track, objective, language and time zone. In a 30-minute video session the person reviews the recommendations and chooses one, then meets the coach in a free chemistry session before anyone commits.

items.question: What does our organization see during performance coaching?
items.answer: Your CHRO sees sessions held, hours used, progress against the agreed objective and the parts of the final summary the person chooses to share. Session content, notes and assignments stay between person and coach.

items.question: What are the six performance coaching tracks?
items.answer: Confidence & Self-Belief, Focus & Prioritization, Resilience, Communication Under Pressure, Time & Energy and Overcoming Setbacks. The person chooses one with the coach in the chemistry session.

items.question: Is performance coaching delivered virtually?
items.answer: Yes. Edstellar delivers performance coaching virtually on Meridian, with every session on video and people seeing times in their own time zone. Language and time zone are part of how coaches are matched.
